title: Iconic paranormal show exploring 'haunted' Edinburgh locations available to stream
excerpt: The nostalgic show is the perfect binge-watch over the remaining October period.
content:
An iconic 2000s paranormal reality programme which explores multiple 'haunted' locations across Scotland - including Edinburgh - is now available to stream for free.

Widely considered part of British reality TV's golden age, this nostalgic show is the perfect binge-watch over the remaining October period for those looking for something spooky, reports The Record.

The programme, hosted by Yvette Fielding and her husband Karl Beattie, follows a team of paranormal experts as they launch investigations into haunted locations, using psychic mediums and scientific equipment.

Originally airing from 2002 until 2014, what some fans may not realise is that the show is actually still running today with all of the same cast from the original series. With 28 series so far, this show will take a while to complete. However, many will be most interested in watching the iconic original episodes which most Brits will remember.

‌

The show in question is, Most Haunted, which fans have hailed as "magnificent" in its heyday.

Who is in the show?

Most Haunted is led by Yvette Fielding as her and her brave team investigate alleged paranormal activity in supposedly haunted locations across the United Kingdom and abroad.

In the original series, the small team would lock themselves in castles, prisons, and manors overnight to hunt for ghosts using historical context, mediums, and scientific equipment.

Other key cast members include Fielding's husband, producer and investigator Karl Beattie as well as camera man Stuart Torevell. Resident spiritualist mediums like the late Derek Acorah and David Wells also appeared in the earlier seasons.

Which Most Haunted episodes are Scottish?

Most Haunted featured several iconic episodes across Scotland, most notably visiting the Edinburgh Vaults, Culzean Castle, and Mary King's Close, all of which are famously 'haunted' locations.

In the first ever series of the show, the team explored the cliffside castle of Culzean where medium Derek claims to hear the music of a legendary ghostly piper

‌

In the second series, they moved onto the Edinburgh Vaults for their investigation of the 19 dark, damp arches beneath South Bridge associated with infamous body snatchers Burke and Hare.

During their Most Haunted Live: Edinburgh Special in 2006, the team streamed a multi-night live broadcast covering the Blair Street Vaults, Niddry Street Vaults, and a late-night vigil at Mary King's Close.

Other Scottish locations across the show included Leith Hall in Aberdeenshire and Coats Memorial Church in Paisley.

What do viewers think of it?

As Most Haunted has been on air for so many years, it garnered quite the fanbase.

‌

Viewers discussing the show gathered on a Reddit thread to share their thoughts.

One wrote: "I absolutely adored Most Haunted as a teenager, it was stupid campy fun. It was hilarious when Derek would get “possessed” and call on Sam for guidance. But nothing beat them all running and screaming in the darkness."

They added: "But when an episode was a bit more spookier I would turn off the lights and run up the stairs a little bit faster."

A second reminisced: "Most Haunted was great TV which millions loved."

‌

A third penned: "It was brilliant. Derek Acorah and Sam. Poor Stuart who always seemed to fall over/get bumped on the head etc. Absolute nonsense of course, but magnificent all the same."

Another fan disagreed: "I don't think the show is totally faked, but I think they deliberately misinterpret stuff and edit the show to make things look 'more' paranormal."

Where can I watch old seasons?

The original first six seasons of Most Haunted are available to stream on Amazon Prime Video.

However, the other 21 seasons of the show are not on the platform. Fans are able to watch other selected seasons of the show on Sky Go and Tubi.
